issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]{は|wa-topic}雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}降[ふ]りませんでした。今日[きょう]{も|mo-also}降[ふ]りません。
issues.problem: English 'It isn't raining today' does not match 降りません (that would be 降っていません); は is equally natural for 雨 in the negative sentence but was not listed.
issues.action: Changed to 今日[きょう]{も}降[ふ]らないでしょう / 'It probably won't rain today either'; added は as alternative in the 雨 slot.

issues.jp_before: お茶[ちゃ]{を|o-object}ください。水[みず]{も|mo-also}ください。
issues.problem: Distractor まで ('even water, please') is grammatical and close to the additive meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor まで with が.

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]{は|wa-topic}サッカー{が|ga-stative}好[す]きです。野球[やきゅう]{も|mo-also}好[す]きです。
issues.problem: Distractor まで ('he even likes baseball') is natural and nearly the same additive meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor まで with で.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は|wa-topic}日本語[にほんご]{が|ga-stative}分[わ]かります。ドイツ語[ご]{も|mo-also}分[わ]かります。
issues.problem: Distractor まで ('he even understands German') is natural and nearly the same additive meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor まで with で.
